name: YMCA Day Camp of Hooksett
description_short: A YMCA day camp at Hooksett Memorial School for ages 6–16, with weekly themes. Activities include swimming (at the YMCA of Downtown Manchester), sports, archery, arts & crafts, gaga ball and nature. There are also teen camp, Leader In Training and Counselor In Training programs.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming happens off-site at the YMCA of Downtown Manchester. The page does not describe swim levels or supervision.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Hooksett Day Camp | The Granite YMCA

warnings: This page shows the 2026 season, which ended before today (2026-10-13). Dates and details for 2027 are not posted yet. All sessions recorded here are the 2026 weeks.

Registration opening depends on who you are: returning campers Dec 1, 2025; Y members Jan 5, 2026; non-members Feb 2, 2026 (all at 10:00 am). Because of this, the per-session registration date was left blank.
Not every program runs all 9 weeks: the LIT program is two weeks and the CIT program is four weeks. The 9 theme weeks shown apply to the main camp; teen program dates are not given.
Hours: 8:30 am–4:00 pm. Free before care 7:00–8:30 am and free after care 4:00–5:30 pm.
